title: 第9章 陈素仪
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
还清贷款之后，林玄再往九仙商盟内的灵物售卖处走去。

    相比散修广场，九仙商盟内显得安静许多。

    柜台后坐着一名青袍鉴定师。

    此人看上去四十余岁，面容清瘦，眼神平淡。

    见林玄披着斗篷进来，也没有多问，只随意抬了抬眼。

    “道友要卖什么？”

    林玄走到柜前，取出三只玉匣，依次打开。

    三块拳头大小的紫金石静静躺在玉匣之中。

    紫金色光泽在厅中灯火下流转，一缕锋锐的金石灵气随之散开。

    青袍鉴定师收起原本懒散的神态，认真起来。

    他伸手取过其中一只玉匣，仔细看了片刻，轻轻点头。

    “唔，一阶上品的紫金石。”

    “品相倒是挺完整，灵性也保存得不错。”

    说罢，他从袖中取出一件形似单片眼镜的法器，夹在右眼之上。

    法器表面灵光流转。

    片刻后青袍鉴定师放下玉匣，又依次查验另外两块紫金石。

    “三块紫金石，其中两块保存相当完好，合计可给二百一十块灵石。”

    “剩下一块边角有缺，灵性也略散了些。”

    “应该是还未完全成型就被取走了，只能给八十七块灵石。”

    “总共二百九十七块灵石。”

    林玄闻言，眉头微微一皱。

    “道友这价，压得有些狠了吧。”

    青袍鉴定师神色不变。

    “我们九仙商盟收货，向来按品相定价。若道友觉得不值，大可去别家问问。”

    “这样吧，凑个整。三百块灵石。”

    “若道友还嫌低，那便只能另寻买家了。”

    三百块灵石，比林玄原先预估的价格还要高些，他略作沉默，点头道。

    “成交。”

    灵石入袋的那一刻，林玄只觉得整个人的底气都足了许多。

    这还是他来到天寰修仙界以来，第一次拥有这么多灵石。

    怎么说呢，有钱的感觉就不一样。

    离开九仙商盟后，林玄又去了一趟妙丹阁。

    走进妙丹阁后，一名侍女迅速迎了上来。
content_en:
After paying off the loan, Lin Xuan went to the spiritual object sales place in the Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance.

    Compared to the Rogue Cultivator Square, the Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance seemed much quieter.

    There is a green-robed appraiser sitting behind the counter.

    This man looked to be in his forties, with a thin face and dull eyes.

    Seeing Lin Xuan coming in wearing a cloak, he didn't ask any questions, he just raised his eyes casually.

    "What do fellow Taoists want to sell?"

    Lin Xuan walked to the cabinet, took out three jade boxes, and opened them one by one.

    Three fist-sized purple stones lay quietly in the jade box.

    Purple-gold luster circulates under the lights in the hall, and a sharp golden and stone spiritual energy spreads out.

    The green-robed appraiser put away his lazy demeanor and became serious.

    He reached out and took one of the jade boxes, looked at it carefully for a moment, and nodded slightly.

    "Well, a top-grade purple gold stone."

    "The appearance is quite complete, and the spirituality is well preserved."

    After saying that, he took out a magic weapon shaped like a monocle from his sleeve and clamped it on his right eye.

    The spiritual light flows on the surface of the magic weapon.

    After a while, the green-robed appraiser put down the jade box and inspected the other two purple gold stones in turn.

    "Three purple gold stones, two of which are quite well preserved, can give a total of two hundred and ten spiritual stones."

    "The remaining piece is chipped at the corners, and the spirit is a little loose."

    "It was probably taken away before it was fully formed, so it could only be given eighty-seven spiritual stones."

    "A total of two hundred and ninety-seven spiritual stones."

    Lin Xuan frowned slightly when he heard this.

    "My fellow Taoist, this price is a bit steep."

    The green-robed appraiser's expression remained unchanged.

    "We in the Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance always price goods according to their quality. If you feel it's not worth it, you can ask elsewhere."

    "Let's put it together. Three hundred spiritual stones."

    "If Taoist friends still think the price is too low, then we can only find another buyer."

    The price of three hundred spiritual stones was higher than Lin Xuan's original estimate. He was silent for a while and nodded.

    "Deal."

    The moment the spirit stone was put into his pocket, Lin Xuan felt that his whole body was much more confident.

    This is the first time since he came to Tianhuan Immortal Cultivation World that he has so many spirit stones.

    How can I put it, the feeling of having money is different.

    After leaving the Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance, Lin Xuan went to the Miaodan Pavilion again.

    After entering the Miaodan Pavilion, a maid quickly greeted him.
